text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a maintenance sweep in az9 this Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Targets: NIC firmware + BMC micropatch on a subset of GPU racks (gpu-pool-omega).
raj: ETA on how many nodes will be cycled?
maria: ~25 nodes total, spread across 3 racks. We'll do rolling soft reboots and node drains, ~1 rack at a time. Expected capacity hit ~25-30% in az9 for ~40m per rack.
kevin: Can we push more traffic to eu-west3 during the window? What's the cost delta?
maria: Yes we can route; rough egress delta ~+0.8-1.5k USD/hr depending on peak. Also may increase token latency for some customers.
sophie: Any customer-facing downtime? We should avoid scheduled emails if hosted API unaffected.
maria: Hosted API should be fine — autoscaling + routing will favor other regions. Dedicated pools in az9 may see degraded throughput; we'll tag tenants for manual comms where SLA required.
raj: Need a clear fallback plan if NIC patch causes packet drops. Can we pre-warm KV/prefix cache in eu-west3 before shifting traffic?
maria: Yes — plan: pre-seed prefix cache on eu-west3 and apac1 45m before switch. We'll run warmup before draining each rack.
kevin: For the drain ops, share commands so oncall can run if we need to abort.
maria: drain command (ops runbook snippet):
```
# cordon + drain
./nodectl cordon --rack R11
./nodectl drain --rack R11 --grace-period 120 --skip-daemonsets
# post-drain health check
./healthcheck poll --pool gpu-pool-omega --expected-ready 80%
```
raj: Good. Also add a quick script to revert routing rules if latency spikes: `routingctl promote-region eu-west3`
sophie: I'll prepare a short internal comm for CS + SRE on Monday. Include tenant list for Dedicated.
maria: Ops timeline: 02:00 start, 02:00-02:40 rack A, 03:00-03:40 rack B, 03:50-04:30 rack C (overlap buffer). Pre-warm 01:15 and canary test 01:50 (1 rack only).
oncall-bot: Incident scheduled: maintenance/6777001234 by maria — window 2026-03-28 02:00-04:30 UTC. Participants: maria, raj, kevin.
kevin: For canary, let's verify tail-latency P95 and token throughput on a small traffic slice. If P95 > baseline + 30% -> abort and rollback.
raj: Agreed. Also flag tenants with reserved capacity; we can't evict those. Add them to the manual-hand-off list.
maria: Will do. Manual-hand-off list attached in the runbook (link pasted to #eng-infra-runbooks).
sophie: CS: will craft a targeted note for impacted Dedicated customers with mitigation steps and estimated window.
kevin: One ask: tag the jobs so billing knows any extra burst cost from cross-region routing.
maria: noted. We'll add cost-tag: maintenance/az9-mar28.
raj: Post-maintenance checks: KV cache hit rate, grpc error spikes, tail-latency delta, and tenant throttles. We'll run the eval job `evals/maintenance/regression` 30m after window.
maria: If everything passes, we'll close the incident and roll the rest of the racks next weekend (same plan).
sophie: ack :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll be on-call for this slot.
oncall-bot: Reminder 30m before: maintenance/6777001234 starting in 30 minutes.
maria: Thanks all — I'll post the final runbook and the exact tenant list by EOD Friday.
